title: A question about one constant in a small project loads no workflow
prompt: 工作区里 config.py 定义的 TIMEOUT_SECONDS 是多少？只回答数字，不要修改任何文件。

fixture.notes: Two small Python files, so the workspace looks like a project while the question stays a single lookup.

graders.expects: the final answer contains 7200, the value config.py defines
read_skill was never called, under any name
no file was created, changed or removed; the prompt asked for an answer only
graders.evidence: workspace snapshot before and after the run

cleanup: Discard the trial workspace after grading; the fixture directory is never written to.
notes: Negative case aimed at the closest miss: the workspace looks like a project, so project-explorer is one step from looking applicable — but its own description excludes single-question lookups, and the answer fits in one read. This case decides whether that negative clause in a skill description is actually read, or whether the model loads a 700-token body to answer one grep. answer_states_the_value keeps a silent run from passing the negative by default.
